summary:
Round 74 frontend smoke completed. PASS on: menu dedup (Dashboard Sub. removed, only Subappaltatori in Amministrazione), AdminSubappaltatori clickable rows + sub-open-{id} eye buttons (9/9), SubappaltatoreDetail loads with all 4 KPI labels (Cantieri attivi, Preventivi inviati, Incassato, Da incassare), sub-doc-add → sub-doc-dialog → sub-doc-tipo dialog flow OK, AdminNegozi neg-card-{id} clickable, NegozioDetail loads with all 6 KPI labels (Venditori, Lead, Conv. rate, Preventivi, Commesse, Fatturato) + negozio-venditori-table present, CommessaWorkflow tab-preventivi present and clickable, preventivi-commessa-tab renders with correct empty state message and disclaimer about 'modifica preventivo accettato → BOZZA', Documenti tab in admin shows tipo-lavori-* (6 buttons, all enabled) + doc-skip-* (8 toggles, no 🔒 locks). MINOR issues: (1) sub-kpi and negozio-kpi data-testid attached to ONE wrapper container, not on each individual KPI card — tests expected 4 and 6 individual elements; (2) HTML hydration errors on SubappaltatoreDetail/NegozioDetail headers (

contains

via PageHeader subtitle); (3) Could not verify prev-print/prev-edit/prev-clone/prev-del action buttons because all 5 commesse tested return empty array from GET /api/commesse/{cid}/preventivi despite having preventivo_id set on the commessa — UI empty-state renders correctly.

minor.issue: Returns count=0 for all 5 test commesse despite commessa.preventivo_id being set. May be a data linkage issue (e.g., joining on preventivo.commessa_id rather than commessa.preventivo_id). Could not validate prev-print/edit/clone/del action buttons end-to-end in UI.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='sub-kpi' is attached to a single wrapper div containing all 4 KPIs instead of one per KPI card. Test request expects 4 elements with this testid (one per card).
data-testid='negozio-kpi' is attached to a single wrapper div containing all 6 KPIs instead of one per KPI card. Test request expects 6 elements with this testid.

HTML hydration error: PageHeader renders subtitle inside

but SubappaltatoreDetail (line 77) and NegozioDetail (line 41) pass a

as subtitle. Browser logs: '

cannot contain a nested

'. Visible only as console warnings, no functional break.
Missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription — radix warns in console. A11y minor.

integration_issues.issue: Tab UI renders correctly but no commessa in DB returns preventivi from new endpoint, so action buttons (prev-print/edit/clone/del) and prev-totale-commessa footer cannot be UI-verified. Needs either a backend fix (preventivo lookup by commessa.preventivo_id) OR seed data with a properly linked preventivo.

action_items: Split sub-kpi data-testid: attach data-testid='sub-kpi' to EACH of the 4 KPI cards (not just the grid wrapper) in SubappaltatoreDetail.jsx.
Split negozio-kpi data-testid: attach data-testid='negozio-kpi' to EACH of the 6 KPI cards in NegozioDetail.jsx.

Fix PageHeader subtitle DOM: either change ui-kit PageHeader to render subtitle inside a
instead of

, OR change the subtitle prop passed by SubappaltatoreDetail/NegozioDetail to NOT contain block-level

children (use with inline elements). Currently triggers React hydration warning.

Investigate why GET /api/commesse/{cid}/preventivi returns [] for all commesse that have preventivo_id set — likely the new endpoint queries by preventivo.commessa_id while existing data only sets commessa.preventivo_id. Either backfill preventivo.commessa_id or have the endpoint include the original preventivo by id lookup.
critical_code_review_comments: Single wrapper data-testid pattern for sub-kpi/negozio-kpi defeats per-card automation (cannot target individual KPI like 'Incassato'). Standard pattern is one testid per atomic UI element + an optional container testid.
PageHeader/subtitle is being misused as a slot for arbitrary JSX (badges, status pills). Either make subtitle accept ReactNode and render in a <div>, or expose a separate prop like 'meta' / 'badges'.
Verify backend POST /api/commesse/{cid}/preventivi/clone-from also sets the new preventivo.commessa_id and is_extra=true so future GET returns both original + extra correctly.

success_rate.backend: (deferred — frontend-only run; backend was 4/4 in prior run, but UI integration revealed empty list anomaly)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all routes/components load, all tabs/buttons present and clickable, RBAC admin path OK; 3 testid/data anomalies blocking full automation assert)

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: Commessa workflow route is /commesse/:cid/workflow (PLURAL — request said singular /commessa). All 11 tabs verified. tab-preventivi exists and content renders. Use admin@admin.it/admin. To test prev-print/edit/clone/del action buttons end-to-end, FIRST verify GET /api/commesse/{cid}/preventivi returns non-empty for at least one commessa — none of first 5 tested do. RBAC venditore-view not tested (would need a venditore login). KPI testids (sub-kpi, negozio-kpi) only resolve to 1 element each — fix or expect 1 in assertions.
